scripts.dev:backend: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe) { .\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 --app-dir backend } else { python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 --app-dir backend }"
scripts.test:backend: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path backend\.venv\Scripts\pytest.exe) { .\backend\.venv\Scripts\pytest.exe backend\tests -v } else { pytest backend\tests -v }"
